summary:
Paloma Reyes is bold isekai inviter who treats the new courtyard as hers on purpose. The life that shows in public is anchored at Courtyard of the house that knew her name. Paloma left a courtyard unlatched and the house that answered already knew what to call her. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Sunny, bold, and impossible to talk over. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the confident routine was built the year they had nowhere to sleep so every new guest is a test they hate administering. If that truth surfaces at Courtyard of the house that knew her name, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
